title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Hilton Jr. claimed off waivers by Packers
items.desc: The Packers claimed WR Chris Hilton Jr. off waivers.
items.impact: Hilton will compete for a depth role in the Packers wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Dru Phillips dealing with minor knee injury
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Dru Phillips has a minor knee injury.
items.impact: It doesn't appear to be too serious. Phillips could miss some practice time early in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Greg Newsome II dealing with minor knee injury
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Greg Newsome II has a minor knee injury.
items.impact: It doesn't appear to be too serious. Newsome could miss some practice time early in the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Abdul Carter has hand injury
items.desc: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Abdul Carter has hand injury.
items.impact: It does not appear to be anything serious for Carter.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Caedan Wallace traded to Dolphins
items.desc: The Patriots have traded Caedan Wallace to the Miami Dolphins.
items.impact: It was previously reported that Wallace was released by New England. He instead gets a fresh start in Miami via a trade.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marquez Valdes-Scantling battling shoulder injury
items.desc: Marquez Valdes-Scantling did not practice on Sunday due to shoulder soreness.
items.impact: Archer notes that Valdes-Scantling had a hard fall during practice. He is competing for a depth role in the Cowboys wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jake Bobo (hamstring) returns to practice
items.desc: Jake Bobo returned to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Bobo was absent from practice the past two weeks due to a hamstring injury. He'll remain in a depth role in the Seahawks wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyron Hudson waived by Bears
items.desc: The Bears waived WR Kyron Hudson with an Injury designation.
items.impact: Hudson will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ray-Ray McCloud III signs with Bears
items.desc: The Bears signed WR Ray-Ray McCloud III.
items.impact: McCloud appeared in two games with the Giants last season. He will compete for a depth role at wide receiver and on special teams.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Aidan Keanaaina placed on IR
items.desc: The Lions placed DT Aidan Keanaaina on injured reserve.
items.impact: Keanaaina is likely to miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: John Michael Schmitz Jr. dealing with concussion
items.desc: Giants coach said John Michael Schmitz Jr. has a concussion.
items.impact: Schmitz will have to clear concussion protocol before he can return to practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Hankerson waived by Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins waived RB Anthony Hankerson.
items.impact: Hankerson will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick McCloud signs with Dolphins
items.desc: The Dolphins signed CB Nick McCloud.
items.impact: McCloud had 27 tackles and two passes defensed in 15 games for the Bears last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Dolphins secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zane Gonzalez placed on IR
items.desc: The Dolphins placed Zane Gonzalez on injured reserve.
items.impact: Gonzalez suffered an undisclosed injury over the weekend. He is likely to miss the upcoming season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Troy Andersen released by Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons released LB Troy Andersen.
items.impact: Andersen has struggled to stay healthy with Atlanta. He'll figure to seek another opportunity and a fresh start.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D.J. Reed Jr. (groin) not dealing with serious injury
items.desc: Lions coach Dan Campbell says D.J. Reed's injury is not considered serious.
items.impact: Reed is dealing with a groin injury. He is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Skylar Thompson hopeful to play in preseason opener
items.desc: The Ravens are hopeful for QB Skylar Thompson to play in the team's preseason opener.
items.impact: Thompson did not practice on Sunday due to a minor injury. He is day-to-day for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Travis Jones (pec) expected to return to practice soon
items.desc: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said he expects Travis Jones to return to practice soon.
items.impact: Minter said he expects Jones to practice "real, real soon." He remains on the PUP list.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Damien Lewis (calf) expected to see reps in preseason
items.desc: Damien Lewis is expected to see some work in the preseason.
items.impact: Lewis is working his way back from a calf injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Javon Hargrave activated from PUP list
items.desc: The Packers activated DL Javon Hargrave from the PUP list.
items.impact: Hargrave has been cleared to return to training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Shawn Bowman signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed TE Shawn Bowman.
items.impact: Bowman will compete for a depth role in the Cardinals tight end room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Eugene Asante signs with Cardinals
items.desc: The Cardinals signed LB Eugene Asante.
items.impact: Asante most recently spent time in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Cardinals linebacker room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Muse waived by Lions
items.desc: The Lions waived TE Nick Muse.
items.impact: Muse signed with Detroit last week. He will figure to seek another opportunity.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Amen Ogbongbemiga signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed LB Amen Ogbongbemiga.
items.impact: Ogbongbemiga was released by the Bears in February. He'll add depth in the linebacker room for Detroit.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bump Cooper Jr. signs with Lions
items.desc: The Lions signed CB Bump Cooper Jr.
items.impact: Cooper recently spent time in the UFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Lions secondary.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Lucas waived by Buccaneers
items.desc: The Buccaneers waived corner Chase Lucas with a failed physical designation.
items.impact: Lucas had been sidelined during training camp. He'll figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Williams signs with Bucs
items.desc: The Bucs signed S Xavier Williams.
items.impact: Williams will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Tampa Bay.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kisean Johnson signs with Packers
items.desc: The Packers signed WR Kisean Johnson.
items.impact: Johnson previously spent time in the CFL. He will compete for a depth role in the Packers wide receiver room.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Marlon Jones waived by Packers
items.desc: The Packers waived/injured Marlon Jones.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.

items.author: Cooper Kleinberg
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) making 'terrific progress,' could play Week 1
items.desc: The 49ers are confident TE George Kittle will be ready for Week 1 against the Rams.
items.impact: Kittle suffered an Achilles tear during last year's postseason, leaving uncertainty about his status entering 2026. However, he appears to be making excellent progress in his recovery, leading San Francisco to believe he will suit up for Week 1. Kittle has been drafted as a low-end TE1 throughout the summer, but could see a rise in ADP with this news.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Trey Sermon signs with Falcons
items.desc: The Falcons signed RB Trey Sermon.
items.impact: Sermon appeared in four games with the Steelers last season. He will compete for a depth role in the Falcons backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) progressing, not cleared for team drills yet
items.desc: Malik Nabers continues to make progress, but he still wasn't participating in team drills on Monday.
items.impact: Stapleton notes that Nabers "looked to be opening up during his rehab work early and then with the training staff on opposite field as team drills went on." He was able to participate in position drills with the quarterbacks again as he continues to make progress.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Quinnen Williams signs three-year extension with Cowboys
items.desc: The Cowboys and DL Quinnen Williams have agreed to terms on a three-year, $105.9M extension.
items.impact: The deal makes Williams one of the highest paid defensive lineman in the NFL. He was acquired in a trade from the Jets last season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Christian McCaffrey sitting out Monday practice
items.desc: Christian McCaffrey is sitting out the 49ers practice on Monday due to "tightness."
items.impact: This is certainly not great news for fantasy managers who are relying on McCaffrey, and for 49ers fans who have already seen plenty of their stars go down. Of course, no reporting has said McCaffrey is missing any more time, but the fact that he's already experiencing some muscle tightness is concerning.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: J.K. Dobbins leaves Monday practice with trainers
items.desc: J.K. Dobbins left the Broncos practice on Monday with trainers.
items.impact: There's little information to follow after that. There could be an injury, but if it is, it's not readily apparent, which is a good thing. It's possible it was just cramps. So fantasy managers need to stay level headed while details are sparse, and wait for more info to make any sort of decisive action.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jaylen Waddle (muscle strain) not practicing Monday
items.desc: Jaylen Waddle remained absent from practice on Monday.
items.impact: Waddle went down in practice last week. Broncos coach Sean Payton said he expects him to return to practice this week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Denzel Boston to practice with first-team offense
items.desc: Browns coach Todd Monken said rookie WR Denzel Boston will move into first-team offense.
items.impact: Boston continues to show out early on in training camp. He is slated to compete for an immediate starting role.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jawaan Taylor expected to return to practice Monday
items.desc: Falcons coach Kevin Stefanski said he expects Jawaan Taylor to return to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Taylor opened training camp on the PUP list. He has been cleared to return to practice.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Xavier Worthy (shoulder) returns to practice Monday
items.desc: Xavier Worthy was back practicing at Chiefs training camp on Monday.
items.impact: Worthy missed time during practice last week. The Chiefs had their full wide receiver room on the field on Monday.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Zavion Thomas (knee) considered day-to-day
items.desc: Zavion Thomas is day-to-day with soreness in his knee.
items.impact: Thomas left Sunday's game early with the injury. He isn't expected to miss much time.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tank Dell takes part in full team drills Monday
items.desc: Tank Dell took part in full team drills on Monday.
items.impact: It is another step in the right direction for Dell as he works his way back from back-to-back season-ending injuries. He remains hopeful to be good to go for the start of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. not seen practicing Monday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. was not seen in uniform at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Pittman got banged up in Saturday's practice. There will be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf not seen practicing Monday
items.desc: DK Metcalf was not seen in uniform in Monday's practice.
items.impact: Metcalf was not in team periods at the end of Saturday's practice. There should be an update on his status when available.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cyrus Allen participates in 11-on-11s Monday
items.desc: Cyrus Allen returned to participating in 11-on-11s on Monday.
items.impact: It was the first time in training camp both Allen and Rashee Rice participated in 11-on-11s on the same day.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Golden (toe) not expected to practice Monday
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he does not expect WR Matthew Golden to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Golden also missed practice on Sunday. He remains day-to-day. It is unknown how serious his injury is.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Reed (ankle) not expected to practice Monday
items.desc: Packers coach Matt LaFleur said he does not expect WR Jayden Reed to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Reed also missed practice on Sunday. He remains day-to-day. It is unknown how serious his injury is.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Makai Lemon (hamstring) still not practicing Monday
items.desc: Makai Lemon remained absent from practice on Monday.
items.impact: Lemon has been sidelined for close to a week due to a hamstring injury. The rookie continues to work his way back to full health.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Laremy Tunsil (torn triceps) will undergo surgery
items.desc: Commanders coach Dan Quinn said Laremy Tunsil will undergo surgery to repair his torn triceps.
items.impact: Tunsil suffered a torn triceps on Saturday. There should be a better sense of his timeline after the surgery. He is expected to miss most of the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Terrion Arnold to visit with Saints
items.desc: Terrion Arnold will visit with the Saints.
items.impact: Arnold met with the Seahawks on Sunday and the Texans previously. His legal situation remains unclear, but he is drawing interest from teams for now.
